label: China: NMPA (Drug Administration Law)
summary: Changes are classed by risk: approval (a supplementary application to CDE), filing (before implementing) and report (in the annual report). The holder classifies each change with the NMPA technical guidelines for chemical drugs and biological products. A domestic site change goes through the production licence first.

label.title: Provisions for Drug Package Inserts and Labels (SFDA Order No. 24)

categories.label: Not used in China yet
categories.rule: China has no post-approval change management protocol or established conditions route in force; see the result.

categories.label: Another procedure (not a change filing)
categories.rule: The change goes through another procedure named in the result.

categories.label: Not a registration change: managed in the quality system
categories.rule: Nothing in the registration changes, so no filing is needed; manage it under GMP and change control.

categories.label: Report change (minor): annual report
categories.badge: Do, then report in the annual report
categories.rule: A minor change: make it under change control and report it in the annual report.

categories.label: Filing change (moderate): file before implementing
categories.rule: A moderate change: file it before implementing (with the provincial MPA for a domestic drug, with CDE for an imported drug). The filing is published within 5 working days and reviewed within 30.

categories.label: Production licence change, then registration update (domestic site change)
categories.rule: A domestic site change goes to the provincial MPA as a production licence change with inspection and technical review; the registration record is updated afterwards.

categories.label: Approval change (major): supplementary application
categories.rule: A major change: submit a supplementary application to CDE and implement only after approval, within 6 months of it.

categories.label: New registration application
categories.rule: The change makes a new product (for example a new dosage form or route): apply for a new registration.

multipleChanges.rule: Related changes can be submitted together; the submission follows the highest category, and a combined supplementary application has a longer review time limit (80 working days).

REPORT.label: Report in the annual report (due by 30 April for the previous year)

FILE.label: File before implementing; the filing is published within 5 working days and the regulator reviews it within 30

LICENCE.label: production licence change by the provincial MPA (15 working days, plus inspection and technical review)

SUPP.label: CDE review time limit of 60 working days (80 for a combined application, 200 with an inspection or clinical data review), then the approval decision; implement within 6 months of approval

NEW.label: New registration: about a year of review

supp.label: Change description, classification and risk assessment
Prior approval status: registration certificate and earlier approvals

file.label: Change description, classification and risk assessment
Prior approval status: registration certificate and earlier approvals

pi.label: Revised package insert (说明书), with a comparison of old and new text

licence.label: Production licence change application to the provincial MPA (outside the dossier)

changeLog.text: First China edition: approval, filing and report changes under the Provisions for Drug Registration and the 2021 Provisions for Post-approval Changes, with the NMPA chemical and biological technical guidelines; the 2026 Implementing Regulations (in force 15 May 2026).

eCTD hand-off: supplementary applications, filings and report changes start a sequence in the eCTD Dossier Builder's new China region (NMPA eCTD v3.2.2, voluntary since 29 December 2021, scope widened from 27 January 2025). Module 1 codes follow the China Module 1 there (1.3.8 change description, 1.4.1 prior approvals).
